summary: Revision 2 per human-review-2026-07-25-rail-revision: sidebar Projects group simplified to one entry per project (label links to the portfolio, duplicate 'All projects' folder removed); Biomni-style second rail added with DBTL Cycles (inline four-dot phase control), the selected cycle's To-Do list, and project conversations, persisted per project in localStorage; chat now renders as the third rail at /workspace/projects/{project_id}/chats/{thread_id} with the rail kept mounted; legacy projectless conversations route to /workspace/chats under an 'Unfiled chats' entry. No DBTL orchestration, no backend change. Frontend lint, typecheck, unit tests, and production build all pass.
